note: THE ROOMS REGISTRY — the walk-in surfaces of the University: the classroom, the specimen and
model pages around it, and the whiteboard where the mathematics is drawn live.
Same contract as generators/labs.json: every served file is a VERBATIM copy of a named path at
a named commit of a source repository, verified byte-for-byte on every build by
build_rooms.cjs, which fails the build on any drift. Copies are never edited; fixes land in
the source repository and the pin advances.
TWO SOURCE REPOSITORIES, one per wing: the flagellum laboratory (classroom + specimen bench +
models + architecture + state snapshot + licensed microscopy) and the minecraft colony (the
whiteboard pair). Each vendored file records its repo-relative source path; the public mirror
commit for deep links is recorded once per source. On 2026-08-31 every file below was proven
BLOB-IDENTICAL between the private working HEAD and the public mirror commit named here
(git ls-tree sha1 equality, 29 of 29), so verifying against the local clone verifies what a
reader can fetch from the mirror.
WHY THE SERVED PATHS LOOK THE WAY THEY DO: these pages were written against a local viewer
that serves them at /classroom, /models, /architecture, /snapshot, / — and the classroom
requests its art at /assets/classroom/* and its microscopy at /assets/media/*. The copies are
not edited, so this site serves them at THE SAME ABSOLUTE PATHS, which is what keeps every
internal link and fetch inside the vendored pages working without touching a byte. The two
fetches that expect a live viewer API (/api/classroom, /api/models) fail closed into the
pages' own catch branches — the rooms state what is static about themselves.
The whiteboard pair links /model, /organism, /defects and / among themselves; /model and
/organism are served here verbatim, /defects is redirected to the published defects register
in the wiki, and / is this site's entry.
